create_descriptor_pool: create a DescriptorPool instance to dynamically manage protocol buffer descriptors at runtime
add_file_descriptor_proto: add a FileDescriptorProto to the pool using the Add method to register new proto types
find_message_type_by_name: find a message type descriptor by its fully qualified name using FindMessageTypeByName
find_extension_by_number: find an extension field descriptor by message descriptor and field number using FindExtensionByNumber
get_default_pool: get the default DescriptorPool singleton instance using the Default helper function
